title: IMAP main.rs ignores credential_file; credential_file documented but never loaded
description: imap/src/main.rs calls CredentialStore::from_credentials(&config.auth.users) only. The stoa_auth::AuthConfig has a credential_file field (documented as 'Loaded at startup') but IMAP never reads it. An operator who configures auth.credential_file in imap.toml will get silent auth failure for all file-sourced users. Reader and smtp both handle credential_file; IMAP does not.
